## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of what the problem is. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated
when [...]")

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, or references here.

## Alignment with Voodoo's architecture

If you're familiar with Voodoo's design principles, does this feature
align with the project's direction? See [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md)
for the architectural vision and invariants.

- [ ] This feature fits within an existing sprint or the backlog
- [ ] This feature doesn't require new required dependencies
- [ ] This feature maintains local-first / zero-infra defaults
